name: mada-trips
description: Mada Trips monorepo: the mobile app (apps/mobile) and shared code (packages/shared). Mada Ops (platform/) keeps its own package and lockfile so its Vercel deploy is unchanged.

scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck --workspaces --if-present && npm --prefix platform run typecheck
scripts.test: npm run test --workspaces --if-present && npm --prefix platform run test
scripts.lint: eslint apps/mobile packages/shared && npm run lint:copy -w @mada/shared
